Nurturing a Thriving Logistics Community: Infinite PL and Falak Investment Hub's joint efforts go beyond silos and enable co-existence, abiding by one of the first and most important rules of innovative ecosystems.

They are dedicated to nurturing a thriving community of logistics entrepreneurs, talents, investors, decision makers, and regulators to complete the cycle and enable a single conversation to carve the way for innovation in the logistics sector.
This approach will set the stage for next-generation advancements in logistics, propelling the industry towards a more efficient and sustainable future.

Building a Dynamic Ecosystem: The primary goal of this partnership is to establish a dynamic ecosystem of startups and technology alliances that will act as a driving force for change within the logistics industry.
Together, they will identify and leverage market opportunities, capitalizing on emerging trends and disruptive technologies to transform the logistics landscape.
The MoU between Infinite PL and Falak Investment Hub marks a significant milestone in the logistics sector.

Through robust go-to-market strategies, revolutionary innovation programs, and the cultivation of an innovation community, Infinite PL and Falak Investment Hub are set to redefine logistics standards and drive industry-wide advancements.
Together, they will shape the future of logistics, unlocking new possibilities and opportunities for businesses worldwide.
About Falak Investment Hub: Falak Investment Hub is a fully-fledged investment firm that supports technology startups and entrepreneurs in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

In line with this commitment, Falak is advancing its Flagship ClimateTech Accelerator Program, launched in partnership with Roots Ventures.

This initiative aims to accelerate the development and deployment of innovative climate startups within their early stages that address critical environmental challenges in the Middle East and North Africa region.
The program leverages Falak’s expertise in entrepreneurship and innovation, coupled with Roots Ventures’ experience in sustainability-focused venture building.
Ibrahim Abdulqader Alhelali, Executive Director of the UN Global Compact Network in Saudi Arabia, added, “We are thrilled to welcome Falak Investment Hub to our network.

Their dedication to sustainability and innovation through initiatives like the Flagship ClimateTech Accelerator aligns perfectly with our mission to drive corporate responsibility and sustainable development.
Through the Flagship ClimateTech program, we aim to contribute to these initiatives by nurturing startups that offer sustainable and impactful solutions.
We invite startups at the seed and post-seed stages with innovative climate solutions to join the Flagship ClimateTech Accelerator Program and be part of our journey towards a sustainable future.
